title: Ramp two-tone heading
description: A single-weight neo-grotesk heading whose first clause is in full ink and the rest in a 60% hushed grey, in five sizes from the 64px hero down to 20px card titles; left or centred.
notes: the hushed part uses text-muted-foreground; themes where that is close to the ink lose the effect
name: ramp-heading

props.name: lead
props.description: the first clause, in full ink

props.name: rest
props.description: the rest of the sentence, in hushed grey (optional)

props.name: breakBeforeRest
props.description: put the hushed part on its own line instead of running on
